question: Fit a Cox model to assess the effect of gene signature score (low/medium/high) on progression-free survival, adjusting for age and sex, using low as the reference category. Report hazard ratios, 95% CIs, and p-values.

expected_output.guidelines: Each contrast row's hazard ratio and 95% CI bounds must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; p-values must match within +/-0.01; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
